_sheet: Systems of the mod. One row = one C# class with one job. Preflight checks that each class exists in src and that every sheet it owns is referenced from it.

_columns.owns: sheets or generated tables this class is built from
_columns.dependsOn: other system ids, comma separated; - = none
_columns.testedBy: how it was verified (filled in during testing)

rows.responsibility: BepInEx entry: config, Harmony PatchAll, event subscriptions, per-frame tick, scene changes
rows.testedBy: Loaded by BepInEx 5.4.23.3 in PEAK 2.6.b on 2026-10-09 (LogOutput.log: plugin loaded, Harmony patches applied, no errors after fixes)

rows.responsibility: the handler bodies the generated patches call; turns game moments into Session/Effects calls
rows.testedBy: In-game: RunManager.StartRun -> opening session; Campfire.Light_Rpc -> campfire session (DevKeys F9 + real flow); SteamLobbyHandler.OnLobbyCreated -> net.log line; CharacterRegistered re-apply; effects log line after each pick

rows.responsibility: find the ROUNDS folder: config override, then Steam libraryfolders.vdf + appmanifest_1557740.acf installdir, then every library's common/ROUNDS
rows.testedBy: Found C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\ROUNDS via Steam manifest on this PC (log line "ROUNDS 2022.3.34f1 at ...")

rows.responsibility: open ROUNDS's assets with AssetsTools.NET, read every pool CardInfo (name, text, stats, rarity, theme, icon), textures and sound clips; builds RoundsCard records matched to cards.json by GameObject name
rows.testedBy: Read 67 cards (67 in pool), 29 textures, 21/21 sounds, 147 strings, themes from level0 in 0.3-0.8 s (background thread) on every launch

rows.responsibility: the playable deck = cards.json rows with inDeck and a matching RoundsCard; deals a hand with ROUNDS rarity weights and allowMultiple rules from a seed
rows.testedBy: 58 playable cards built; hands dealt with rarity weights (hands logged); allowMultiple respected

rows.responsibility: per-character card lists -> summed ClimbStats -> applied to the character's public fields (all clients) and consulted by the Harmony hooks (owner)
rows.testedBy: Effects log after picks: Tank -> sprintMultiplier 2.00 -> 1.98; baseline captured (jump 400, throw 5-50, hunger 0.0005); hook-only stats (toughness/regen) covered by the Harmony prefixes loading without error

rows.responsibility: host: collects arrivals, orders players last-arrival-first, deals hands, advances turns, times out; everyone: tracks whose turn it is and opens the picker on their own turn
rows.testedBy: Opening pick on the beach and campfire pick after Light_Rpc, both host-ordered; click pick (session 10001 card 40, 10002 card 59); 60 s host timeout auto-pick verified (card 8, card 56); out-of-turn guard in place; multi-player order untested (solo only)

rows.responsibility: RaiseEvent send helpers, EventReceived dispatch, late-joiner StateSync
rows.testedBy: RaiseEvent round trip through Photon (codes 91/92/94 seen in logs, self-delivery via ReceiverGroup.All); StateSync self path; late joiner untested (solo)

rows.responsibility: runtime-built uGUI: picker fan, waiting banner, my-cards HUD, toasts, ROUNDS-missing notice
